mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.birth_date, u.phone_number, u.pin_password, p.nickname, u.user_status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.withdrawn_at FROM user_tbl u LEFT JOIN profile_tbl p ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.birth_date, u.phone_number, u.pin_password, p.nickname, u.user_status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.withdrawn_at FROM user_tbl u LEFT JOIN profile_tbl p ON u.user_id = p.user_id WHERE u.phone_number = #{phoneNumber}

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.birth_date, u.phone_number, u.pin_password, p.nickname, u.user_status, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.withdrawn_at FROM profile_tbl p INNER JOIN user_tbl u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.nickname = #{nickname}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_tbl ( user_name, birth_date, phone_number, pin_password, user_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userName}, #{birthDate}, #{phoneNumber}, #{pinPassword}, #{userStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )
